lines.beaver: 예절 교육 과정표, 비중은 어떻게 나눴어요?
lines.beaver_en: How did you divide the weight in the etiquette course plan?
lines.beaver_roman: yejeol gyoyuk gwajeongpyo, bijungeun eotteoke nanwosseoyo?
lines.learner: 전체에서 기본 예의범절의 비중이 가장 높아요.
lines.en: Basic etiquette and manners take up the largest share overall.
lines.roman: jeoncheeseo gibon yeuibeomjeorui bijungi gajang nopayo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you plan to teach respect for elders?
lines.learner: 장유유서를 중심으로 어른을 받드는 법을 다뤄요.
lines.en: We cover how to serve elders, centered on respect for seniority.
lines.roman: jangyuyuseoreul jungsimeuro eoreuneul batdeuneun beobeul darwoyo.

lines.beaver: 아침 문안 인사 같은 것도 들어가요?
lines.beaver_en: Is something like morning greetings to elders included too?
lines.beaver_roman: achim munan insa gateun geotdo deureogayo?
lines.learner: 네, 가정 예절에서 문안의 비중이 꽤 높아요.
lines.en: Yes, greetings to elders make up a big part of home etiquette.
lines.roman: ne, gajeong yejeoreseo munanui bijungi kkwae nopayo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you also cover hosting etiquette?
lines.learner: 네, 손님 접대는 두 번째로 비중이 커요.
lines.en: Yes, hosting guests has the second-largest share.
lines.roman: ne, sonnim jeopdaeneun du beonjjaero bijungi keoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How will the practice sessions work?
lines.en: We practice step by step, starting with knocking before entering.

lines.beaver_en: What about when you receive a gift?
lines.learner: 답례하는 법과 정중히 사양하는 법을 같이 배워요.
lines.en: They learn both how to return the favor and how to politely decline.
lines.roman: damnyehaneun beopgwa jeongjunghi sayanghaneun beobeul gachi baewoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How will you deal with rude behavior?
lines.learner: 사례를 보여 주고 무례가 왜 문제인지 토론해요.
lines.en: We show examples and discuss why rudeness is a problem.
lines.roman: saryereul boyeo jugo muryega wae munjeinji toronhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: It would be nice to have a joint class, too.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 후속 과정에서 합동 실습을 넣을게요.
lines.en: Good idea. I'll add joint practice in the follow-up course.
lines.roman: joayo. husok gwajeongeseo hapdong silseubeul neoeulgeyo.

lines.en: Role-plays will bring energy to the class.

lines.beaver_en: Sounds good. Shall we finalize it like this?
lines.learner: 네, 제가 과정표를 정리해서 보내 드릴게요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll tidy up the course plan and send it to you.
lines.roman: ne, jega gwajeongpyoreul jeongnihaeseo bonae deurilgeyo.
